purpose: One controlled same-prompt demonstration, not a benchmark or outcome guarantee.

intentionalVariable.treatment: Approved UIZZE Agent Connector skill and authenticated hosted MCP workflow only.

controls.filesystemScope: one isolated seed worktree per condition
controls.runScheduling: baseline and treatment start concurrently after one shared preflight
controls.dependencies: none; seed uses browser HTML/CSS/JavaScript and Node standard library verification

completionRule: Stop at the first agent completion response or 20 elapsed minutes, whichever occurs first. Preserve partial or failed output as the result.
rerunPolicy: No reruns. If infrastructure fails before the model receives the prompt, invalidate both sides and restart both from the locked seed. If failure occurs after prompt receipt, retain it as outcome evidence.
manualEditPolicy: No manual UI or code edits after either prompt. Redaction may cover secrets only and must be logged.

creativePolicy.sourceOnly: All comparison visuals must be direct captures of the real seed/product flow. No generated illustration, reconstruction, or one-sided polish.
creativePolicy.sameCapturePath: Both conditions use scripts/capture.mjs with the same viewport, state order, dwell time, reduced-motion setting, and video encoding path.
creativePolicy.channelUse: Channels may crop raw captures without redesigning them. Any surrounding UIZZE identity must reuse the existing landing-page implementation and tokens unchanged.
